description: soundcloud: Artist Tracks. GET /v1/soundcloud/artist/tracks. Provide one of: handle, url. Gets tracks/songs for a SoundCloud artist by handle or URL. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cursor.description: Cursor to get more tracks. Get 'cursor' from previous response.

handle.description: SoundCloud artist handle. Provide handle or url.

url.description: SoundCloud artist tracks URL. Provide url or handle.
